name: Breguet classical watch
summary: The plain, exact gold watch that Abraham-Louis Breguet made in Paris from 1780. It has an engine-turned silver dial, blued steel hands with an open tip and a coin-edge case. Its movement set the rule for the dress watch.

philosophy.core_thesis: A fine watch shows its worth by exact work and a quiet face, so each part is plain, thin and cut by hand.
design_principles: Turn the silver dial on a rose engine in a tight pattern of fine lines, checks or barley corns.
Print slim Arabic or Roman numerals and keep the minute track thin.
Blue the steel hands in a flame and cut each tip as an open ring, the Breguet hand.
Cut a fine coin edge on the case band, so that the thumb finds the edge.
Keep the case thin and round: the bow, the pendant and the crown carry no extra ornament.
Put the small seconds dial off centre, at 6 or 10 o'clock, and leave the middle of the dial clear.
Add a secret signature near the 12 that shows only in raking light.
Bend the end of the hairspring in an overcoil, so that the spring opens and closes in an even circle.
anti_patterns: A crowded dial with bold block numerals
A chrome or steel case with a sport bezel
Printed fake engine turning on a flat dial
Bright coloured hands or a coloured dial
A thick case with large lugs and a heavy crown
Machine-stamped patterns that copy the look of hand turning

silhouette.shape: A thin round pocket watch, about 45 to 50 mm wide and 8 to 12 mm thick. It has a small round bow on a plain pendant.
silhouette.line: A clean circle with a slim fluted band; no part rises far above the glass.
silhouette.fit: The watch rides in the waistcoat pocket on a chain, and the thin case lies flat against the body.
silhouette.proportion: Case thickness to width is about 1 to 5. The dial fills about 85 per cent of the case width. The minute hand reaches the minute track.
rules: Keep the bezel narrow so that the dial fills the face.
Set the hour hand at the inner ring of numerals and the minute hand at the outer track.
Make the bow small and round, with no flat shoulder.
Leave the middle of the dial free of sub dials and printed words.

fabrics.rule: Use precious metal and fired enamel for the parts that show, and blued steel for the hands. Hide the brass plates and the ruby bearings inside.

methods: coin-edge cutting on the case band
construction.closures: A hinged back and a hinged glass bezel snap shut on the case; the owner winds the watch with a key or a crown.
construction.details: A secret signature and a serial number on the dial, a scratched number inside the case, and slim hands over a pure dial.

surface.pattern: Engine-turned checks, barley corns or rings on the silver dial; a fine coin edge on the case band.
surface.gloss: Polished gold at 70 to 90 GU; white enamel at 80 to 100 GU; blued steel at 40 to 60 GU.
surface.wear: Gold and enamel wear well; the enamel can show hair cracks and the gold shows rub marks, and a watchmaker can polish and restore both.

palette.strategy: Pale metal and white enamel for the field, one deep blue for the hands, and a small touch of ruby red in the bearings.

processes: fired enamel on a gold ground
hand finishing of plates and bridges
case making in gold by hand
making.scale: One master with a small team worked in a Paris workshop. Each watch was made by hand for a named client. A complex watch took years.
making.signs: A secret signature and a number on the dial, a fine coin edge on the band, and open-tip blued hands.

pieces.form: Thin round gold case with a coin-edge band
Engine-turned silver dial with off-centre small seconds
White enamel dial with slim black numerals
Slim round dress watch with open-tip hands

positive: blued steel hands with open tips
macro photograph of a watch dial, soft light

evidence.title: Breguet et fils - Watch with Benjamin Franklin - Walters 58147

emotion.target_response: A calm trust in exact, quiet work: the viewer sees fine lines, a clear dial and a case with no waste.

use_cases: a period prop for a drama of the 1790s
a dress watch brief in the classical mould
a museum note on early precision watches
an image prompt for a gold pocket watch
avoid_when: the brief wants a sports or a tool watch
the brief wants a bold, coloured dial
the brief is a digital or smart device

modifiers.how: Make the dial white, flat and bold with black Arabic numerals, and set the movement in a plain gold-filled case.
Shrink the case to 30 mm, add wire lugs and a leather strap, and keep the plain dial.
